mn96:3.5: This is the service they prescribe for a brahmin.
mn96:3.8: This is the service they prescribe for an aristocrat.
mn96:3.11: This is the service they prescribe for a peasant.
mn96:3.15: This is the service they prescribe for a menial.
mn96:10.6: This is the wealth they prescribe for a brahmin.
mn96:10.9: This is the wealth they prescribe for an aristocrat.
mn96:10.12: This is the wealth they prescribe for a peasant.
mn96:10.15: This is the wealth they prescribe for a menial.
mn96:12.14: If they incarnate in a family of aristocrats they are reckoned as an aristocrat.
mn96:12.15: If they incarnate in a family of brahmins they are reckoned as a brahmin.
mn96:12.16: If they incarnate in a family of peasants they are reckoned as a peasant.
mn96:12.17: If they incarnate in a family of menials they are reckoned as a menial.
mn96:15.4: An aristocrat is capable of taking some bathing cleanser, going to the river, and rinsing off dust and dirt;
